description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form handler for creating and editing node content types, including form construction, validation, entity building, and saving logic.

classes.name:
Drupal
ode/Form
odeTypeForm
classes.description: Form handler class for managing node type creation and editing in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting the entity field manager dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the node type form with fields for name, machine name, description, submission settings, workflow, language, and display options.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring the machine name is valid and not '0'.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Creates or updates the node type entity from form values, ensuring description and help are not empty strings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the node type entity, updates field labels and workflow defaults, and redirects to the collection page.
